scripts.db:gen-types: npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id ilefwfpvphadsbptiaur --schema public > src/types/database.ts.tmp && grep -q '^export type Json' src/types/database.ts.tmp && mv src/types/database.ts.tmp src/types/database.ts || (rm -f src/types/database.ts.tmp; echo 'db:gen-types failed; src/types/database.ts left unchanged'; exit 1)
scripts.db:seed: echo 'Run seed SQL files via Supabase CLI or SQL Editor. See scripts/run-seeds.ts for details.'
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:seed && npm run db:snap-access-points
scripts.db:fix-geometry: npm run db:import-rivers && npm run db:verify-directions && npm run db:snap-access-points
scripts.video:render: cd remotion && npx remotion render Root tutorial-full out/eddy-tutorial-landscape.mp4
scripts.video:render:vertical: cd remotion && npx remotion render Root tutorial-full-vertical out/eddy-tutorial-vertical.mp4
scripts.video:render:all: npm run video:render && npm run video:render:vertical
